svg.title: Which parts of mod-ui each feature touches
svg.desc: A matrix of eighteen features against eight components: the browser, the webserver, the session, the host, the addressing and device-link modules, libmod_utils, mod-host and the files on disk.
svg.metadata:
GENERATED by docs/mod-ui/diagrams/src/build.py from specs.py (features). Do not edit this file by hand. Content of the diagram as Mermaid or plain data (a summary for readers and AI tools; the layout lives in specs.py):

svg.text: Addressing: knobs, pedals, MIDI, CV, BPM
HMI only · tuner.py · no page in html/
User files, NAM and IR models, Tone3000
The host is involved in 14 of 18 features, the pedals (addr · hmi · cc) in 9, libmod_utils in 10, mod-host in 12.
The session, the only layer meant to sit between the webserver and the host, appears in just 8.
